name: EZX10RF
description: A plug-in whole-house X10 RF transceiver and Insteon scene controller: X10 wireless transmitters, or X10 signals on the powerline, trigger up to 20 Insteon scenes.

notes: Its X10 RF range is up to 200 feet, from a built-in antenna that should point up. It can be set to ignore stray X10 signals from neighbors.

To learn an X10 address and link responders: hold the SET button 10 to 12 seconds (the LED flashes about once a second); send the X10 address and On (the LED flashes faster); set each responder to the state wanted and hold its SET button about 5 seconds; end by holding the EZX10RF's SET button about 5 seconds. Then tap it 1 to 31 times to add an Off delay of half a minute per tap, from 0.5 to 15.5 minutes, and hold it about 5 seconds; if the LED keeps blinking, press it once more.
To unlink, follow the linking steps with the X10 Off command in place of On.
Factory reset: unplug it for at least 10 seconds, then hold the SET button while plugging it back in, for about 5 seconds.
The Quick-Start Guide EZX10RF Wireless Sensor Receiver Insteon EZX10RF—Model #5010G applies to firmware 1.5 and above.
